target_customer: Pharma and research partners needing African genomic data, plus Nigerian patients and hospitals
problem: Africans were about 2% of genome wide association study data, limiting drug discovery relevance.
business_model: Biobank and genomics research services and drug discovery partnerships

founders.name: Gatumi Aliyu
founders.background_notes: YC page; later CPO at Vendease.

exit.reason: Could not continue operating financially per TechCabal sources; winding down from July 2023, assets including biobank explored for sale

technical_complexity.rationale: Sequencing lab, biobank logistics and hospital data capture in Nigeria; capital and operations heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive African biobank samples were hard to replicate, but depended on continued funding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; the company failed on its own finances.

market_need_then: Africa contributed about 2% of GWAS data (Technext, July 2019).

branding.name_origin: Named for Africa's 54 countries per several outlets.
branding.brand_signature: The 54 countries name tied to a pan African mission

brand_strength.rationale: The name carried the pan African mission and press repeated it, but the company's collapse came from governance and cash, not brand.

outcome_analysis: 54gene raised about $45 million across a $4.5 million seed, $15 million Series A and $25 million Series B to build an African biobank, then ran short of cash in 2022 when a planned raise collapsed. It laid off about 30 percent of staff in August 2022, cut more in October when the founder stepped down as CEO, and began winding down in July 2023. Allegations about the founder were not proven and are not coded.
notes: Series A and seed amounts from Technext and Techpoint search listings; Series B opened directly. A later down round was reported by one outlet and is not recorded. Employbl total of $113M conflicts and is treated as unverified. Competitors: H3Africa predates the batch but its source page found was dated 2022, so none listed. 54gene.com returned 503. Founder education and prior employers not found.
